description: Election Commission - Declare that K. Kanapathippillai as a Member of the Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities elections.
